scope: bounded nearest-precedent review; not exhaustive systematic survey

sources.title: egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation
sources.finding: Reusable analyses, semantic facts, dynamic/conditional rewrites, and local-cost extraction are established baseline capabilities.
sources.limitation: General framework; does not supply a Tau atomless-BA checker. Original 2021 DOI, not the later CACM republication.

sources.title: Improving Equality Saturation for EDA via Semantic E-Graphs
sources.finding: Semantic identifiers directly drive merging; composite identifiers propagate equalities. Matched egglog variants isolate representation costs.
sources.limitation: Hardware-focused construction and evaluation; neither a Tau implementation nor evidence of Tau performance.

sources.title: Omelets Need Onions: E-graphs Modulo Theories via Bottom-up E-Matching
sections: 3 Generalized Union Finds and Semantic E-ids
sources.finding: Semantic e-ids, theory canonizers, black-box SMT canonization, and extract/simplify/reinsert or sidecar-solver approaches are explicit conceptual precedents.
sources.limitation: Preprint design discussion, not a matched Tau benchmark or proof of the proposed Tau bridge.

sources.title: Rewrite Rule Inference Using Equality Saturation
sections: 3.3 Candidate Rules: canonical representation, characteristic vectors, validation
sources.finding: E-graphs compact candidate terms; evaluated fingerprints filter candidate equalities before a supplied validator. Boolean model checking and larger-domain SMT are evaluated.
sources.limitation: Fingerprints can be sampled; matching is not a validity proof. Exact support semantics would be a domain-specific validator, not a new generic architecture.

sources.title: Souper: A Synthesizing Superoptimizer
sources.finding: Solver-checked superoptimization and caching successful/failed optimization mappings in memory and persistent storage precede the Tau registry.
sources.limitation: LLVM IR semantics and deployment differ. The retrieved PDF is a revised 2018 manuscript under the 2017 arXiv identifier.

sources.title: Graph-Based Algorithms for Boolean Function Manipulation
sections: Conclusion: shared graphs and computation caching
sources.finding: Fixed-variable-order reduced BDDs are canonical Boolean-function representations; sharing and cached operations are established.
sources.limitation: Propositional functions, not direct quantification over arbitrary BA elements. Fixed order matters; BDD compactness need not imply a compact emitted Tau tree.

sources.title: Guarded Successor: A Novel Temporal Logic
sources.finding: Distinguishes BA term/formula normal forms; gives atomless-BA QE and fixed-variable/fixed-constant finite quotient bounds.
sources.limitation: Reading the theorem is not independently verifying Tau implementation correctness. The reviewed experiment does not cover temporal GS or arbitrary interpreted constants.

sources.title: Small Proofs from Congruence Closure
sections: V Greedy Optimization of Proof Tree Size
sources.finding: Proof-generating equality saturation in egg and proof-size optimization have established implementations and empirical evaluation.
sources.limitation: Certificates justify congruence/equality from admitted equations; they do not automatically prove the validity of a domain-specific semantic oracle.

sources.title: SymPy Logic documentation
sources.finding: Established CNF/DNF simplification baseline with an explicit exponential-time warning and default 8-variable simplification limit.
sources.limitation: Only use compatible Boolean terms or opaque-predicate propositional skeletons; not full atomless-BA QE. Translate back and compare with one common cost model.

sources.title: dd maintainer documentation
sources.finding: Pure-Python dd.autoref and compatible dd.cudd interfaces offer a practical shared-ROBDD baseline.
sources.limitation: Documentation checked, package not installed or benchmarked by this lane. Boolean quantification must not be relabeled atomless-BA QE.

sources.title: CC(X): Semantic Combination of Congruence Closure with Solvable Theories
sources.finding: Congruence closure using semantic values rather than canonized terms is an older direct precedent.
sources.limitation: Publisher/PDF open failed. Primary paper text was readable in indexed retrieval, corroborated by Nextmap reference 8; no artifact replay. Ground solvable-theory combination is not atomless quantified Tau.

sources.title: Checking Equality-Saturation Merge and Extraction Certificates
sections: Theory listing: Egg_Flat_Explanation, EGraph_Explanations, Extraction_Certificates, Acyclic_EGraph_Extraction, Certified_Acyclic_EGraph
sources.finding: The development entry describes verified executable checking of egg flat explanations and minimum additive-cost extraction over acyclic e-class DAGs.
sources.limitation: Mutable development entry, dated 2026-07-14; release-page open failed. Only entry inspected, no Isabelle replay. Visible status listed AFP/5c0d018c7389 and Isabelle/a414adcf84d0, checked 2026-10-03. Do not cite as stable release or claim independently audited proof.

sources.title: BoolE: Exact Symbolic Reasoning via Boolean Equality Saturation
sources.finding: Boolean equality saturation and domain-specific extraction have already been applied to reconstruct arithmetic components from optimized gate-level netlists.
sources.limitation: Adjacent application, not a general Boolean-expression minimizer or atomless-BA QE baseline. Reported performance was not reproduced here.

sources.title: Slotted E-Graphs: First-Class Support for (Bound) Variables in E-Graphs
sources.finding: Efficient sharing modulo variable renaming and binder-aware e-graph semantics already have a dedicated construction.
sources.limitation: Conditional precedent if the Tau work claims binding/alpha-sharing novelty; not needed for a deliberately fixed-context root-only pilot.

manuscript_reference_note: Structured references preserve the bounded study source ledger. Bibliographic author lists are not guessed. URLs and DOIs identify sources; source access and limitations are retained.
